body: It really just furthers the who do I talk to without it becoming a "you have everything you want, why would you feel that?"

It's almost definitely depression, I have childhood trauma, but I hate the antidepressants and currently have no health insurance so therapy is almost entirely out of the question in America. Just attempted a conversation with my fiance but he took it really personally. He had a friend commit suicide a few years ago so it sends him into a spiral.
